text:
erin: FYI — planned cross-cluster rollout tonight during change window (23:00-01:00 UTC). This includes values change for db connection pool + secrets rotation. Deploy bot already scheduled the run.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for chart redwood/worker-service@v2.4.1 to eu-west-1 at 23:15 UTC. Canary size=2 pods, timeout=10m. Reply with `abort` to stop.

alice: Order I propose: eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 -> apac-sg. Stagger 10m between clusters to watch eviction and DB connections.

ben: Question — secrets rotation will trigger rolling update on all nodes, any risk of node-level eviction causing bursty connections? We saw that last month.

carla: We should pin chart to v2.4.1 for this rollout and keep a rollback image tag ready (v2.4.0-rollback). Also enable drain-safeguard: `podDisruptionBudget: minAvailable: 80%` in values for this release.

dave: Add a preflight job that runs `helm template` + `kubeval` and a small load test against canary pods to validate steady DB connections. I can push a jenkins job.

erin: Good. I'll update release notes with the exact values change and the rollback steps. Also adding manual hold signal: @eng-oncall can `@deploy-bot hold <thread_ts>` to pause between clusters.

alice: Preflight commands for reference:
```
# render checks
helm template redwood/worker-service --values values-release.yaml | kubeval --strict
# smoke test against canary svc
curl -sS http://canary-worker.internal/health | jq .status
```

ben: If we see >5% 502s or connection errors during canary, plan is immediate rollback to v2.4.0 and pin. Confirm?

carla: Confirm. Also ensure metrics alert for consumer-side 5xx triggered in the first 10m unblocks manual rollback. I added alert rule `canary_http_5xx_rate > 0.05 for 1m`.

deploy-bot: Canary passed health checks at eu-west-1 after 6m. Prometheus alerts: none. Proceeding to next cluster in 10m.

dave: Noted — kubectl drain command to use during node patching (if needed):
```
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

erin: Heads-up: release notes updated in the release-notes repo (PR #412). Added rollback steps, pin instructions, and the change window. I'll be on standby. :eyes:

alice: If anything looks off during us-east-1, please call the manual hold. @ben @carla you'll be monitoring alerts and logs.

ben: Will watch logs and DB pool metrics. I have a quick script to snapshot p99 latency and active connections every 30s.

carla: If we need to rollback, prefer chart rollback first (helm rollback) then image pin if that doesn't restore health. Documented in PR.

deploy-bot: us-east-1 canary started. Reply `abort` or `hold` to intervene.

erin: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the coordination point.
